source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure of RNA (PDF 174).

blocks.text: RNA aam taur par aik dhaage wala hai, DNA ke baraks, lekin zanjeer khud par mud kar helix jaise lup bana sakti hai. Ribonucleotide zanjeer mein ribose, chaar nitrogen wale bases (A, U, G aur C; thymine ki jagah uracil) aur phosphate groups hote hain. Cells mein RNA ki teen bari qismein hain:

blocks.alt: Baen: nucleotides se bana RNA ka aik strand; har nucleotide mein phosphate group, ribose sugar aur A, U, G ya C mein se aik base hota hai, aur phosphates sugars ko jor kar reedh (backbone) banate hain. Daen: apne aap par wapas mura hua strand; dono baazuon ke bases jore banate hain, A ke saath U aur G ke saath C, aur aik chhota helical stem banta hai, jabke be-jore bases oopar loop banate hain. 5' aur 3' sire neeche hain.
blocks.caption: RNA ki saakht (structure): aik strand jo apne aap par wapas mur sakta hai (Figure 27.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Yahan RNA aur DNA ke teen farq dikhte hain: RNA aam taur par aik strand hota hai, us ki sugar ribose hai, aur us mein thymine (T) ki jagah uracil (U) hota hai. Jahan strand murta hai wahan mukammil (complementary) bases jore banate hain aur zanjeer helical loops banati hai.

items: Messenger RNA (mRNA) nucleus mein DNA se copy kiya jeneyati naqsha le jata hai.
Ribosomal RNA (rRNA) ribosome banane mein madad deta hai.
Transfer RNA (tRNA) mRNA ki nucleotide tarteeb ko protein mein amino acids ki mutaliqa tarteeb mein tarjuma karta hai.

blocks.caption: DNA aur RNA ka muqabla
rows: use le jana aur tarjuma karna (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA)

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa base RNA mein hai lekin DNA mein nahi?
blocks.explanation: Uracil (U), jo thymine ki jagah leta hai.

items: RNA: akela dhaaga, ribose, bases A, U, G, C.
mRNA paigham le jata; rRNA ribosomes banata; tRNA amino acids lata.
